uncertain.note: a point is clearly printed after DV (checked at high magnification); the line is in spaced capitals, so the point is kept on the V with a double space before PARLEMENT.
a small hook-shaped mark sits above the o of 'tations'; read as a plain o (stray ink / show-through from the verso), not a tilde or circumflex — 'annotations' takes no abbreviation mark.
MOIS is set with a little letterspacing after the decorated initial, much less than the title's spaced capitals; transcribed as ordinary capitals, no spaced_caps. The A is the woodcut initial.

justification space printed before the comma ('d'Artigat , au'); normalized away per §1. Same case on lines[8] ('dix ans , fut') and lines[9] ('fort ieune , &'), and no space is printed after the comma in 'Ianuier,mil', 'Tholoſe,contenant', 'tations,de'.
